text.p: Aviation Distributors Inc said it has received approval and commitment from Bank of New York for a new credit facility which will more than double its borrowing power at substantially better terms.
Terms of the commitment provide for establishing a revolving credit facility of $15 million for three years, an increase from the company's previous $6.5 million credit line with a local bank.

Bank of New York expects to finalize all documentation on or before June 30, Aviation said. It intends to use the new credit line to finance receivables, purchase "larger ticket" aircraft parts for immediate resale to customers and to finance future bulk inventory purchases.
Aviation said the credit facility partially eliminates the requirement to insure its foreign receivables, which will lead to a cost savings of about $200,000 annually.
